title: 2D Adaptive on the stock: a stock margin narrower than the tool is refused as "pocket is narrower than the tool", with no band, width or fix named

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:medium
labels.description: One module or crate, a known pattern (issue-worker-medium)

labels.name: P3
labels.description: Wrong behaviour a user hits, with a workaround; fix now

body:
Found by the reporter in v0.26.0 via the AI Chat panel (2026-11-23). Reproduced headlessly with the 0.26.0 `camcraft-cli`; the same code is on `main`.

## What happens

A 2D Adaptive on the stock (source `stock`, no boundary picks) around a 25.4 x 25.4 x 1.27 mm plate, stock from **fit stock** (2 mm per side, top Z 3.27), with a 3 mm end mill (catalog `EM-0300-2FL`), on the Tormach 770MX (ML), refuses at generate with:

```
2D Adaptive1: invalid machining parameters: pocket is narrower than the tool
```

The refusal is right (the area to clear is the 2 mm band of stock around the part, and a 3 mm cutter has no legal position in it), but the message does not say that. There is no pocket in this job, so "pocket" points the user at the wrong thing. It does not say which area is narrow, how wide it is, by how much the tool misses, or what to change. The in-app assistant read it as a missing boundary selection or a too-small helix radius (0.6 mm), and neither is the cause.

Readings (box stock, `dz` 5.27, side margin m per side, same tool and op):

| margin per side | result |
|---|---|
| fit stock (2 mm, Z -2..3.27) | refused: "pocket is narrower than the tool" |
| 1 mm | refused, same text |
| 2 mm | refused, same text |
| 3 mm (= tool D) | generates (Offset rings fallback, notes) |
| 4 mm, 6 mm | generates; the #1655 band note and corner note appear |

So the band check that #1655 added (`machining2d::unreached_note` through `operation::keep_law::narrow_noted`) names a narrow band only when some other part of the area produced a path. When the whole area is one band narrower than the tool, the generator refuses first, with the bare sentence, and the band note never runs.

## Steps to reproduce

`simple.step` is a 25.4 x 25.4 x 1.27 mm plate STEP (any plate of that size works). Script `a.js`, run with `camcraft-cli script a.js`:

```js
cam.import("simple.step", "simple");
cam.call("load_machine", {builtin: "Tormach 770MX (ML)"});
cam.call("fit_stock", {});            // 29.4 x 29.4, Z -2..3.27: 2 mm per side
cam.call("add_tool", {catalog: "EM-0300-2FL"});
cam.call("add_operation", {kind: "2D Adaptive", tool: "EM-0300-2FL", source: "stock"});
cam.generate();
```

Output: `generate: 2D Adaptive1 - could not generate the toolpath: 2D Adaptive1: invalid machining parameters: pocket is narrower than the tool`. Replace `fit_stock` by `set_stock {box: {dx: 31.4, dy: 31.4, dz: 5.27}}` (3 mm per side) and it generates.

## Expected

A refusal that says what is narrow and what to do, e.g. "2D Adaptive1: the stock around the part is a band 2.000 mm wide, narrower than the 3.000 mm tool (plus 0.000 mm stock to leave): no cutter position fits. Widen the stock to at least 3.000 mm per side, use a tool under 2.000 mm, or cut the outside with a 2D Contour." The same refusal stays a refusal (no path is emitted); only its words change. Where the area is a real pocket (a part source, a closed boundary), the text names the pocket and its narrowest width the same way.

## Where

- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket.rs` `pocket_started_on` (the site this job hits: `non_sliver_center(region, off)` empty -> `GenError::Invalid("pocket is narrower than the tool")`), and the same bare sentence in `adaptive_avoid.rs`, `pocket_avoid.rs`, `rest2d.rs`, `rest_prior.rs`, `corner_relief_spur.rs`, `adaptive/rest/mod.rs`.
- `crates/app/src/operation/keep_law.rs` `narrow_noted` / `machining2d::unreached_note` (#1655): already measures the band; it could word the refusal when the whole stock-around-part area is one band.
- `crates/app/src/operation/generate/run_job.rs` `name_outside_entry_refusal` already adds advice to this sentence, but only for Outside containment (#2232), not for the stock source.

Related: #1655 and #1554 (the band note on a generated path), #3631 (warn at edit time when the tool cannot fit a pocket; this issue is the generate-time refusal text, not the edit-time warning).

Priority P3 ("a misleading message" with a workaround: widen the stock or pick a smaller tool). Effort medium: the refusal stays a refusal and no toolpath, gouge check or posted G-code changes (so the safety floor does not apply); the work is wording in the 2D pocket family plus reuse of the existing band measure, with a test.

Done means: on the reproduction above (stock-source 2D Adaptive, 2 mm stock margin, 3 mm tool) generate is still refused, and the refusal names the stock band around the part, its width (2.000 mm) against the tool (3.000 mm), and at least one fix (wider stock or smaller tool), without the word "pocket"; a pinning test in `crates/app/tests/` asserts that text, and the existing "narrower than the tool" asserts still pass.
